model_annotation: This chart illustrates the trend of daily new confirmed COVID-19 cases alongside the number of COVID-19-related news reports over time, as indicated by the title "每日新增患者人数与新闻媒体报道数目变化趋势" (Trend of Daily New Cases and News Media Reports). The horizontal axis represents dates, spanning from approximately 2022年7月1日 (July 1, 2022) to 2022年8月26日 (August 26, 2022), with date labels appearing at irregular intervals. The left vertical axis is labeled "每日新增患者人数" (Daily New Cases), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1,800,000, while the right vertical axis is labeled "新闻媒体每日报道数目" (Daily News Media Reports), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6,000. The chart combines teal/cyan-colored bars representing daily global confirmed cases ("该日全球确诊数量") with a blue line representing the number of COVID-19-related news articles ("有关covid-19新闻数量"). The bars exhibit a recurring cyclical pattern with periodic dips, likely corresponding to weekly reporting cycles, where the shortest bars fall to approximately 350,000–400,000 and the tallest bars reach approximately 1,500,000–1,600,000, with the peak bars appearing around mid-July 2022 (approximately July 15–20). The blue line generally fluctuates between roughly 1,500 and 5,000 on the right axis, with notable peaks around mid-July reaching approximately 4,500–5,000 and another rise toward the end of August. The bars are not sorted by value but are arranged chronologically, and no individual bars appear to be visually emphasized through special shading or annotation beyond the uniform teal color applied throughout.
